prompt:
Photograph of a massive war galleon of the 1620s with two full rows of
red-lidded gun ports, a high wooden stern several decks tall, heavily
carved with galleries, deep red and covered in gilded and painted
sculpture, a long ornate beakhead with a lion figurehead: square
courses, topsails and topgallants, a lateen mizzen with a small topsail,
two square sails on the raked bowsprit, under sail at sea, seen from low
over the water, her bow to the left and a little towards us, a blue sea
with white crests and the open sea running to the horizon all round her
and a sky of soft even blue with a few white clouds, a natural
photograph with no frame, no border and no circle. Historical
reenactment photography, sharp focus, realistic. The whole ship is built
of planked wood: no tower, nothing of stone.
